verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a pricing-page line saying users can grant others view-only access to notes. That is in-app sharing of selected notes, but nothing shows it produces a public, browsable website or digital garden where links between notes work. Markdown export exists, but turning it into a site would mean leaving the app. Missing for 10: documented public website/digital-garden publishing, evidence that inter-note links work for viewers, docs describing the sharing/publishing flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
